verdict.rationale: Per-prompt model routing is a fair axis for a coding agent, but the evidence only shows that OpenHands works with any LLM, that users configure an agent's model, and that `ask_oracle` lets an agent consult a stronger model without switching its active model. None of this documents automatically routing each task prompt to the most suitable model.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have each task prompt automatically routed to the most suitable underlying model
